name: Code block
summary: A framed code sample with a language or file name, a copy button and a scrolling body.
description: Use it for code people will copy: install commands, config, snippets. No highlighter ships; pre-highlighted HTML can use the .v-tok-* classes. Inside long-form text, a plain <pre> in .v-prose is lighter.

classes.name: v-code
classes.description: The frame: card surface, border and radius.

classes.name: v-code-header
classes.description: The top bar holding the label and the copy button.

classes.name: v-code-title
classes.description: A file name instead of a language, cut with an ellipsis when long.

classes.name: v-code-copy
classes.description: Pushes the copy button to the inline end of the header.

classes.name: v-code-body
classes.description: The <pre>. Scrolls both ways; cap its height with --v-code-max.

classes.name: v-code-wrap
classes.description: Long lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways.

classes.name: v-code-numbered
classes.description: Shows line numbers. Wrap each line in .v-code-line.

classes.name: v-code-line
classes.description: One line of code, counted when .v-code-numbered is set.

classes.name: v-tok-keyword
classes.description: Keywords, in the accent text colour.

classes.name: v-tok-tag
classes.description: Tags and selectors, in the accent text colour.

classes.name: v-tok-number
classes.description: Numbers and literals, in the warning colour.

classes.name: v-tok-function
classes.description: Function names, in the info colour.

classes.name: v-tok-property
classes.description: CSS properties, in the danger colour.

classes.name: v-tok-attr
classes.description: HTML attributes, in the danger colour.

states.description: On the .v-code-body <pre>: lets keyboard users focus and scroll code that overflows.

hooks.name: data-v-copy
hooks.value: Text to copy, or empty with data-v-copy-target
hooks.description: Turns the button into a copy button. The label reads "Copied" for 2 seconds.

hooks.name: data-v-copy-target
hooks.description: Copies the text content of that element, so the token markup is left out.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the copy button, then to the code body.
Copies the code (with the JS module).

a11y: The copy result is announced in a live region ("Copied to clipboard"), not only shown in the label.
If the clipboard is blocked, the code is selected instead and the announcement says to press Ctrl+C.
Every token colour is a text-safe token, so highlighted code keeps 4.5:1 contrast.
Line numbers are generated content with user-select: none, so they are not copied.
